payload.core_mechanism_summary: Bottom-up DP over string positions: dp[i] = best (max occurrences, min replacements) for suffix starting at i, with transitions: skip i or match pattern of length m starting at i.
payload.rationale: DP state is defined by index i from n down to 0, exactly 1D. Typical dp_1d_state pattern: each state depends on i+1 and i+m. No 2D grid, recursion, or complex data structure.
